text: The mountain valley opens under winter fog as the quiet landscape is introduced.
Spring and her sheepdog cross the frozen landscape and notice signs of life beneath the snow.
Spring follows strange spirits toward an ancient forest hidden beyond the snowy valley.
The ancient forest reveals a hidden seasonal world beneath its frozen surface.
An ancient guardian spirit blocks the path and tests Spring's resolve.
Spring responds with patience as the guardian awakens and the seasonal transformation begins.
The ice melts, the forest returns to life, and Spring restores balance to the valley.
The story ends with the valley blooming as Spring and her sheepdog continue onward.
Closing credits roll as the Spring film concludes.
